main_body: Adobe desert house: a flat roof terrace (rug, hatch, parapet) over a front wall with an arched door and a lattice window
top_band: Light sand roof surface with a lighter parapet rim, rows ~1-31, ending in a light front-edge strip at rows ~28-31
evidence: Reading down the middle column: a sand roof terrace with parapet, rug and hatch (rows 1-31) reads as a horizontal surface seen from above. A light front-edge strip at rows 28-31 is followed by a dark eave band at rows 32-34, then the wall face (rows 34-63) with its own shading, door and window. The roof is tall for a 3/4 top, but its rug, hatch and parapet make it clearly a roof plane and not a face. The door and window have light frames and a dark lattice, so they read as only mildly inset. No receding side faces.

style.evidence: The roof and wall have 4-5 sand and terracotta steps with scattered speckle and grain. Outlines are dark brown, tinted to the adjacent material, not black. The rug interior, door panels and white door frame are fairly flat, and the roof has no per-tile scallops, so it is a little less rich than the tiled references. For an adobe subject the speckled texture and ramps are acceptable next to them.
